title: Compare decision backends without inventing missing results
narrative: Taloneth compares rules, local model, and System One on a matched ticket. When the decide profile is cold, System One must be marked unavailable — no fake latency or verdict. Related: `nubble_lane_load_hint`, `nubble_model_affinity`.
implementation: `shadow_decision_backends` in `mechaharness.routing` compares backends without inventing unavailable results. `CliInstrumentor` verb `shadow_decision_backends` exposes the diagnostic.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `shadow_backends.yaml`: hard exact unavailable/available/matched action lists.
